# Widget Requirements Quality Checklist: My Services Homepage Widget

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and coverage of the My Services widget requirements.
**Created**: 2026-11-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the service fields and catalog destinations required for each listed row fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006–FR-007]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the identity-resolution and group-membership assumptions documented for signed-in, guest, and unregistered users? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all required existing homepage widgets and links identified as constraints on adding this widget? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is alphabetical ordering clear for services with equal or differently cased displayed names? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the meaning of “View all” clear for services owned directly and through group membership? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the default page size and the condition for paging stated consistently? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, §User Story 3]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Do the definition of “service” and the ownership rules align across functional requirements, scenarios, and assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002–FR-005, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK008 Are lifecycle-display requirements consistent between the listed-service requirements and the no-lifecycle edge case? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §Edge Cases]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK009 Can the 3-second visibility target be measured objectively under the stated “normal conditions”? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK010 Can the ownership accuracy criterion distinguish missing owned services from incorrectly included services? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-002]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK011 Are loading, empty, and unavailable states specified with sufficiently clear user-facing outcomes and recovery expectations? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Are requirements for catalog access restrictions and isolation from other homepage widgets explicit for failure and success scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011–FR-012]
- [ ] CHK013 Is behavior for services without lifecycle values unambiguous and consistent with the normal row requirements? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007, §Edge Cases]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK014 Are direct group membership, catalog user resolution, and the exclusion of parent-group inheritance stated as assumptions that bound ownership behavior? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK015 Are catalog availability and permission behavior documented as dependencies of the widget’s user-visible outcomes? [Dependency, Spec §FR-011–FR-012, §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
